author: Tynvale
body:
Sanctum


As some people may remember, I posted this map as a concept map for my DTA gamemode idea. Since that idea isn't able to happen at the moment, I decided to make a 2 team DTM version of it! I am releasing it now because it is just sitting on my computer.

Map details:

Map Name: Sanctum
Map Creator: Tynvale
Teams: 15 v 15
Map Download: PM me on Skype if you want it!
YAML: Will be done by Zedther.

Map Layout




Inventory

I added a fishing rod to make fights more interesting.

Please give as much feedback as possible, I want the community to be happy with it.

replies.body:
Here's the thing, I'm not really sure. At the risk of nullifying my own feedback, I don't really know how to change it to make it better. Maybe move the iron so that it doesn't block the view of the monuments (helps antirush short term?) and add islands between the center of the map and the monuments to allow attackers to have an extra lane (helps antistall long term?)? Or not, if you don't want to add it, you don't have to; it's your map.   

Sorry if I'm not that helpful, hopefully some play testing the map will help.

replies.body:
I am sorry to say but your map, Sanctum, has been denied for testing on the Avicus Network.

To Improve your map, the map developers suggest you add more structures and elevation to the map. It's currently flat and plain with nothing really on it.


If you have any other questions on how to improve your map, Find me on TeamSpeak or Message me on Skype (Sethskye).


You may resubmit your map once edited.
